title: World-Grounded Reinforcement Learning for Pollution-Aware Bird Movement Modeling Using a Multi-Instance DQN Framework
abstract: arXiv:2611.21895v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Birds are modeled as environmentally sensitive agents whose movement reflects real-world air quality conditions, where AQI serves as a measurable world feedback signal representing pollution-driven consequences. Instead of relying on human preference or synthetic rewards, the system uses environmental outcomes as the primary training signal, enabling policy learning grounded in ecological impact. We propose a multi-instance reinforcement learning simulation in which agents navigate a 2D grid representation of India integrated with a precomputed AQI matrix and geographic state boundaries. The framework combines bird call metadata from the Xeno-canto dataset, spatial discretization, and real environmental data to learn adaptive navigation strategies under pollution constraints. To ensure scalability and efficiency, repeated real-time API queries are replaced by a structured AQI mapping that enables fast lookup during training and execution

translated_title: 基于世界反馈的强化学习用于污染感知的鸟类运动建模：多实例DQN框架
translated_abstract: 鸟类被建模为对环境敏感的智能体，其运动反映真实的空气质量状况，其中AQI（空气质量指数）作为可测量的世界反馈信号，代表污染驱动的后果。该系统不依赖人类偏好或合成奖励，而是将环境结果作为主要训练信号，从而实现基于生态影响的策略学习。我们提出了一种多实例强化学习模拟，其中智能体在印度的二维网格表示中导航，该网格集成了预计算的AQI矩阵和地理州界。该框架结合了来自Xeno-canto数据集的鸟鸣元数据、空间离散化和真实环境数据，以学习污染约束下的自适应导航策略。为确保可扩展性和效率，用结构化的AQI映射替代了重复的实时API查询，从而在训练和执行期间实现快速查找。
tldr: 该论文提出一种多实例DQN强化学习框架，以AQI作为世界反馈信号，结合真实环境数据模拟污染感知的鸟类自适应导航策略。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a multi-instance DQN reinforcement learning framework that uses AQI as a world-grounded feedback signal, combined with real environmental data, to model pollution-aware adaptive bird navigation strategies.
